review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people argue that advertisement brings some benefits for economic, many others hold a different opinion, saying that advertising made people dissatisfied with their life. I believe that there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Admittedly, one might argue that advertising has given rise to several benefits for undeniable economic. Chief among them is creating content and appealing visual effects employed on each platform where they are shown. This tendency is further reinforced by consumers, who spend money on this and help increasing spend power, and encouraged consumers buy this production. So creating more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation, which boost the economy. For example, some e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam, rely heavily on advertisement campaigns to attract their customers, and boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Addition, advertising also create creative some jobs in marketing, media and design, which make it an important driver of economic activity.

On the other hand, one might believe that advertising made people have frustration in their lives with what they own, and advert has negative social consequences. On social media, it constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions which emerge among viewers in foster dissatisfaction. For instance, in particular, young people feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadget by advertised on Tiktok or Facebook, which lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. Finally, leading to a society promoted materialistic values and money in the long run.
In my opinion, both views, valid to some certain extent that advertising may contributed to social dissatisfaction, by it's also play a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ bốn phần trên hai trang.

review.overall: Em đã hoàn thành đủ bốn đoạn, có hai view, ví dụ Shopee/Lazada và ý social dissatisfaction. Tuy nhiên, bài còn ẩu ở lỗi nền tảng và nhiều câu không có cấu trúc hoàn chỉnh, đặc biệt ở Body 1, cuối Body 2 và Conclusion. Em cần viết lại bài này, tự soát từng động từ và từng mắt xích trước khi nộp.

I believe that there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.” giữ nguyên ý nhưng đưa từ/cụm từ về đúng chức năng ngữ pháp trong câu.

paragraphs: Some people argue that advertising brings economic benefits, whereas others believe that it can make people dissatisfied with their lives. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. This encourages people to spend more, which increases production and creates employment opportunities and state revenue through taxation. E-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting their sales and the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements on social media constantly show perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions, which can foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. This pressure can lead to frustration when they cannot afford these items and may promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, both views are valid to some extent. Advertising can contribute to social dissatisfaction, while also playing a crucial role in economic development.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
